brief:
A Gaza survivor has turned to testimonies from Israeli soldiers to understand the psychological toll of warfare, according to Middle East Eye. The account, submitted by Ezzideen Shehab, suggests that examining perpetrators' experiences may illuminate the broader impact of conflict on those involved in military operations.

The piece indicates an attempt to bridge perspectives across the divide by analyzing how combatants cope with the violence they witness and carry out during combat operations in Gaza.

title: Gaza survivor examines how Israeli soldiers process combat trauma
